algorithm: Daily net signed transaction sum, cumulative customer daily closing, arithmetic average over current day plus preceding 29 calendar days only at 30 rows, MAX(avg30,0), maximum per customer calendar month, exclude first transaction month, SUM customer monthly maxima
limitations: History extends to common global cutoff 2020-04-28, not customer last transaction or Apr30
Calendar-day window includes current day, 30 full daily observations; no timezone data
